prompt: Write the body (about 120 words) of a letter of representation from a personal injury lawyer to an auto insurer. The client was hurt in a rear-end collision. Ask that all contact go through the law firm, ask for the policy limits, and ask the insurer to keep all evidence. No salutation, no signature, no names, no dates. (Internal reference C-1173; do not mention it.)
text:
This firm has been retained to represent the interests of our client in connection with a rear-end collision that occurred while our client was lawfully stopped at a traffic signal. Our client sustained injuries that are currently under medical evaluation and treatment, and we expect the full extent of those injuries and associated losses to be documented in the coming weeks.

Please direct all further communication regarding this matter to this office and do not contact our client directly, either by telephone, in writing, or in person. If your insured or any representative of your company has already spoken with our client, please let us know so that we can address it.

We request that you provide a complete copy of the policy declarations page, including the bodily injury and property damage limits applicable to this claim, as well as any excess or umbrella coverage that may apply.

Finally, we ask that your company preserve all evidence relating to this incident, including photographs, vehicle data, dash camera or telematics records, claim file notes, recorded statements, and any communications with your insured. Please confirm in writing that these materials will be retained.
